lauren: heads up — found a leaked service-account key in a public gist. looks like prod-analytics-sa key material. we need immediate rotation, rewrap any secrets encrypted with the affected KMS key, and an audit log sweep. can we coordinate a short runbook?

aj: on it. can you paste the gist link and the filename(s)? @vault-bot pls surface recent vault access for prod paths.

lauren: https://gist.github.com/redacted/abcd1234 — file: prod-analytics-key.json. i removed the raw key from the gist but snapshot shows full JSON. noticed some references to vault transit key: projects/redwood-kms/locations/us-central1/keyRings/analytics-key

vault-bot: [automated] recent access: vault transit/decrypt and transit/encrypt on path transit/analytics-key used 12 times in last 48h by service-account: ci-runner@redwood-prod. no unauthorized vault admin logins. last rewrap operation timestamp: 1688200000.

maya: i'm primary oncall. immediate plan I can execute: 1) revoke the exposed SA key in GCP 2) create a new key pair and rotate where needed 3) disable any long-lived tokens tied to that SA. i'll coordinate with rafael for vault rewraps.

chris: quick question — do we need to rotate the KMS cryptoKey itself or only rewrap secrets with a new key version? if the private key material of the SA leaked, rotating the KMS key isn't strictly required unless the KMS key was exported or compromised. but if any secrets were wrapped with the affected key version we should rewrap to a new version to be safe.

rafael: agreed. suggested runbook (short):
- t+0: revoke exposed SA key (maya) -> remove from IAM & delete key. log action id.
- t+5: create new SA key + distribute to CI with short-lived tokens (aj handles CI update).
- t+10: create new KMS key version:
```
# create new crypto key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=analytics-key --location=us-central1 --keyring=analytics-keyring
# list versions
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=analytics-key --location=us-central1 --keyring=analytics-keyring
```
- t+20: rewrap vault transit-wrapped secrets to new KMS version (rafael executes):
```
# example vault rewrap (transit -> assuming external KMS wrapping plugin)
vault write sys/rewrap rewrap_from=projects/redwood-kms/locations/us-central1/keyRings/analytics-key/cryptoKeys/analytics-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1 rewrap_to=projects/redwood-kms/locations/us-central1/keyRings/analytics-key/cryptoKeys/analytics-key/cryptoKeyVersions/2
```
- t+30: update apps to use new SA key + restart pods as needed (aj).
- t+60: validate by checking audit logs, run smoke tests, and monitor error rates.

lauren: good. add RBAC tightening step: downgrade prod-analytics-sa to least privilege for the immediate window and add an IAM condition limiting usage to CI IPs/time ranges. aj, can you prepare an IAM policy PR?

aj: will open PR to remove editor scope and set only necessary roles: BigQuery DataViewer, Pub/Sub Publisher, Storage Object Viewer. PR #2346. also adding condition: only usable from projects/ci-runner and serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-prod.

chris: also enable/verify audit logging sinks for both KMS and Vault if not already:
```
# example to ensure admin activity logs go to bigquery
gcloud logging sinks create audit-sink bq.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-ops/datasets/audit_logs --log-filter='resource.type="crypto_key" OR protoPayload.methodName:"google.pubsub"'
```

ops-bot: incident INC-5678 created: "exposed SA key + KMS rewrap coordination". assignees: maya, rafael, aj, chris. severity: high.

maya: revoked key_id `abcd-2026-03-18` from prod-analytics-sa at 1871005465. deleted key from IAM. posted deletion audit: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/keys?project=redwood-prod&name=abcd-2026-03-18

rafael: starting vault rewrap now. i'll run in small batches for secrets under secret/data/prod/analytics and transit-wrapped values. rewrap job id: rvw-1871-01. i'll emit progress updates every 5 minutes.

aj: CI creds rotation in progress. creating ephemeral tokens and updating runner secrets. will coordinate with rollout so we don't break prod jobs. estimated 25m.

chris: just a heads up — i'll raise retention of KMS audit logs to 90 days for the project and push an audit snapshot to our secure bucket. also adding alert if any future key export attempts occur.

vault-bot: rewrap job rvw-1871-01: started at 1871005480. affected paths: secret/data/prod/analytics/*; transit keys re-encrypted to cryptoKeyVersion 2.

lauren: perfect. please paste verification checklist here once done: 1) SA key revoked + new key created 2) KMS new version created + rewrap finished 3) vault secrets re-encrypted 4) CI updated 5) RBAC tightened 6) audit logs archived.

maya: step 1 done (revocation) and step 4 partly done (CI tokens rolled for staging). logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/instance/1871005490

rafael: rewrap job completed at 1871005530. summary: 42 secrets rewrapped, no rewrap errors. checksum diff applied to 3 legacy secrets and fixed.

aj: CI update finished at 1871005540. PR #2346 for IAM policy opened. added short-lived token TTL 1h in runner config.

chris: audit sink confirmed and snapshot pushed. retention set.

lauren: great work team. i'll update INC-5678 with timeline and close when we've had 12h of stable metrics and no anomalous KMS usage. please add any postmortem notes to the ticket. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident INC-5678 severity updated -> monitoring period started (12h)"
